messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-transcribe-medium-0261-reverse-04", "row_sha256": "ee4a1fe2a9752edeb99ec0a013064ca2a2190a63db676b485c7d5de8f20a4149", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "please send the camera repair estimate to quentin not mina the camera is a black olympus camera that stopped powering on after it was caught in light rain last saturday the battery still charges in the separate charger and the contacts look clean but the body does not show a charging light when the battery is inserted i brought it to your shop on tuesday with the twenty five millimeter lens attached and asked for a written estimate before any work begins the estimate should list the inspection fee separately from parts and labor and say whether the fee is credited toward the repair if i approve it please include the replacement cost for the battery door latch because it no longer closes flush and mention that the rear screen has a small scratch that was already there when i dropped it off i do not need a cleaning or a firmware update added to the estimate if the repair requires a part that is back ordered please give the expected wait time and leave the camera unrepaired until i reply by email my email address is on the intake form and the best number for a question is the one ending in four eight two six", "output": "Please send the camera repair estimate to Quentin, not Mina. The camera is a black Olympus camera that stopped powering on after it was caught in light rain last Saturday. The battery still charges in the separate charger, and the contacts look clean, but the body does not show a charging light when the battery is inserted. I brought it to your shop on Tuesday with the twenty-five-millimeter lens attached and asked for a written estimate before any work begins. The estimate should list the inspection fee separately from parts and labor and say whether the fee is credited toward the repair if I approve it. Please include the replacement cost for the battery door latch because it no longer closes flush, and mention that the rear screen has a small scratch that was already there when I dropped it off. I do not need a cleaning or a firmware update added to the estimate. If the repair requires a part that is back ordered, please give the expected wait time and leave the camera unrepaired until I reply by email. My email address is on the intake form, and the best number for a question is the one ending in four eight two six."}]
